runSummary.note: Fresh 11.9.2026 05:11 sweep genuinely searched Profesia, direct-company careers, LinkedIn Jobs, Worki, Brigada.sk, Kariera/Zoznam, Praca za rohom, Pretlak/StartupJobs/WordPress-oriented discovery, Upwork, Reddit/public WordPress communities and public Facebook indexing. Strongest new candidate is SPP-distribucia Administrátor/ka lokálneho centra údržby in Bratislava (1,400-1,800 EUR, admin/SAP/orders/factures, B licence, 2 days HO monthly). It passes the BA hard location gate but asks for 2 years similar practice; kept as high-priority candidate because jobs-data requires a safe full-file replacement and this run did not risk truncating the 51-item LIVE feed. Wolt Support Associate Full Time was reverified but carries minimum B2 English and therefore is not promoted. Facebook yielded 0 concrete publicly verifiable hiring posts.
